analysis_1_view_distribution.conclusion: View count exhibits extreme positive skewness; most videos are concentrated in lower view ranges (< 1M views) with a small percentage of viral outliers.

analysis_2_category_distribution.conclusion: The 'Entertainment' category heavily dominates YouTube content, followed by 'News & Politics' and 'Music'.

analysis_3_engagement_by_category.conclusion: 'Science & Technology' yields the highest average user interaction rate relative to total views.

analysis_4_upload_day.conclusion: Peak upload frequency occurs on Friday, while maximum audience engagement rate is achieved on Sunday.

analysis_5_upload_hour.conclusion: Upload volume peaks around 14:00 UTC, whereas videos uploaded around 13:00 UTC generate higher average view counts.

analysis_6_correlation.conclusion: Strong linear correlation between views and likes (0.85) and comments (0.62). Title length shows near-zero correlation with views.

analysis_7_outliers.conclusion: The top 1% viral videos threshold is 9,760,574 views. Highly viral videos often maintain high engagement, though extreme outlier view counts can exhibit lower percentage engagement due to massive passive reach.
